en.hubeali:
Aban, from Abdul Rahman Bin Abu Abdullah, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The woman can get married to whoever she so desires to when she was in control of her affairs. So if she so desires to, she can appoint a guardian’.
en.sarwar: 3. Aban has narrated from ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn abu ‘Abd Allah who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
A woman who has control of her affairs can marry whomever she likes or she can appoint someone as her guardian.’”
